description: ⚠️ SEND a DRAFT envelope to its recipients — this dispatches the signing invitations, is legally binding, and is irreversible. Only call this after the user has reviewed the draft (from create_envelope) and explicitly confirmed. It transitions the envelope to SENT and notifies the first routing-order signers. IMPORTANT: a SENT status does NOT mean recipients were reached. Read the `delivery` object in the response and branch on `delivery.state`: DELIVERED_ALL (everyone got the invite), DELIVERED_PARTIAL (some did not — tell the user who, from `delivery.signers`), DELIVERED_NONE (nobody was reached; the envelope is sent but stuck — do not report it as delivered). `delivery.detail` is a plain-language summary you can relay.

envelopeId.description: ID of the draft envelope to send (from create_envelope)

name: send_envelope
